title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Demand planning and inventory manager
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM based)

Reports to: Senior Operations Manager

Employment Type: Full time

Salary: $35 K USD

About the Role

We are looking for a dedicated, full time Demand Planning and Inventory Manager to own forecasting and inventory accuracy across our portfolio of consumer products brands. This is a company with multiple direct to consumer subscription brands, one single purchase DTC brand, and two wholesale brands sold through major retail partners.

This role sits at the center of how we plan and manage inventory. The single most important thing this person owns is making sure our forecasting is accurate and that our recorded inventory position actually reflects reality, by working closely with our warehouse team to reconcile sales order activity against physical cycle counts every week. You will be the person who catches a forecasting error before it becomes a stockout, who catches an inventory discrepancy before it throws off a reorder decision, and who builds the reporting infrastructure that lets leadership see true inventory health at a glance across every brand and channel.

This is a dedicated, single client role. You will not be splitting your time or attention across other companies or accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning and Forecasting Analyze sales velocity across all DTC brands and forecast demand by SKU Determine and execute reorder timing and quantities for DTC brands to avoid stockouts and overstock Incorporate seasonality trends and channel performance data from ecommerce, Amazon, retail marketplace, and social commerce channels into forecasting and reorder decisions Coordinate directly with our overseas production team on reorder needs, production timing, and inventory availability

Sales Order and Inventory Reconciliation Own the process of pulling sales orders across all sales channels, including wholesale retail partners and marketplace channels, and ensuring inventory is accurately and promptly decremented as orders ship from our warehouse Maintain a real time, accurate view of true available inventory at all times, since forecasting, reordering, and fulfillment decisions all depend on this number being correct Review and reconcile weekly cycle count data provided by the warehouse shipping and receiving coordinator against expected inventory levels based on sales order activity Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, tracing issues back to root cause, whether that is a sales order processing error, a receiving error, or a physical count error Note: this role reviews and reconciles cycle count data but does not have supervisory authority over the warehouse coordinator, who reports separately to the Senior Operations Manager

Reporting and Visibility Maintain a formal reorder tracker and replenishment schedule, kept current and accessible to leadership Build and maintain regular reporting on inventory health, discrepancy trends, forecast accuracy, and stock levels across all brands Proactively communicate inventory risks and planning recommendations directly to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked

Additional Responsibilities Create, track, and reconcile purchase orders, flagging issues before they affect operations Own the shipment calendar and deadline tracking for inventory sent into third party fulfillment centers, including Amazon FBA, ensuring shipments are submitted on time to prevent sales disruption Track replenishment needs and coordinate reorder timing and order minimums with our wholesale retail partners Maintain organized, accessible documentation for vendor contracts and communications

What We Are Looking For Prior experience in demand planning, forecasting, or inventory management, ideally spanning both DTC and wholesale or retail channels Strong analytical skills and genuine comfort working with numbers, forecasts, and reconciliation data in Excel or Google Sheets A precise, detail obsessed mindset, this role requires someone who catches small numerical discrepancies before they become larger problems Experience with Amazon marketplace operations, including FBA shipment coordination, is a plus Experience coordinating with overseas manufacturing or production teams is a plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working with internal teams, vendors, and retail partners Ability to work as a dedicated, full time resource for a single company Comfort working independently in a remote structure with regular reporting cadence to leadership

Reporting Structure

This role reports to the Senior Operations Manager. It works closely with, but does not supervise, the warehouse shipping and receiving coordinator, who reports separately within operations.

Why Join Our Team A stage of company where you will help build forecasting and inventory reporting infrastructure from the ground up, not just follow existing systems Full ownership of demand planning and inventory accuracy across multiple brands A collaborative, low ego team environment where your work has direct, visible impact Steady operational culture that values precision and clear communication

title: Analista de instrumentação e equipamentos de testes
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Instrumentação e Equipamentos de Teste para atuar na gestão, calibração, manutenção e evolução tecnológica dos equipamentos de teste e de toda a cadeia de medição, incluindo sensores, cabos, conectores e sistemas de aquisição de dados.

Esse(a) profissional será uma referência técnica para engenheiros e técnicos, apoiando a seleção, configuração e utilização correta de instrumentação em bancadas e veículos. Também será responsável por assegurar a confiabilidade das medições, a disponibilidade dos equipamentos e a melhoria contínua do parque de testes.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos equipamentos de teste e instrumentação, incluindo inventário, criticidade, padrões, documentação e rastreabilidade. Planejar e acompanhar a agenda de calibração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos. Garantir a conformidade metrológica e a máxima disponibilidade dos sistemas de teste. Diagnosticar falhas e realizar troubleshooting em sistemas de aquisição de dados, sensores, cabos, conectores e módulos de condicionamento de sinal. Identificar e solucionar problemas relacionados a ruído, aterramento, interferência e integridade de sinal. Configurar e comissionar sistemas de aquisição de dados e instrumentação de acordo com as necessidades dos testes. Apoiar a montagem e a validação de setups de instrumentação em bancadas e veículos. Definir, documentar e manter procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e padrões técnicos de instrumentação. Estabelecer boas práticas de medição, montagem, inspeção, manuseio e armazenamento de sensores e equipamentos. Treinar e suportar engenheiros e técnicos no uso correto e eficiente dos sistemas de medição. Realizar análises de obsolescência e mapear necessidades futuras de equipamentos e tecnologias. Elaborar roadmaps para atualização e expansão de data loggers, sensores e acessórios. Apoiar solicitações de investimento e a seleção técnica de novos equipamentos. Atuar como interface técnica com fornecedores e sites globais para alinhamento de tecnologias, métodos e requisitos locais.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓ RIOS

Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou área correlata. Experiência profissional entre 4 e 10 anos em equipamentos de teste, instrumentação, sistemas de medição, laboratórios de engenharia ou áreas relacionadas. Experiência prática com sensores de temperatura, pressão, aceleração e/ou strain gages. Vivência com acessórios de instrumentação, cabeamento, conectores e condicionamento de sinais. Conhecimento sólido dos fundamentos de metrologia e das rotinas de calibração. Conhecimento sobre rastreabilidade metrológica, certificados, tolerâncias e gestão de intervalos de calibração. Experiência com sistemas de aquisição de dados, incluindo configuração, instalação, comissionamento e troubleshooting. Conhecimento sobre ruído, aterramento, blindagem e integridade de sinal. Capacidade de organizar inventários, agendas, documentação e planos de manutenção. Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita, conversação e interação com equipes globais e fornecedores. Disponibilidade para atuação em Curitiba, Paraná .

DIFERENCIAIS

Experiência com sistemas de aquisição de dados Dewesoft . Experiência com equipamentos e soluções IPETRONIK . Vivência com soluções HBM, National Instruments, Vector, ETAS ou plataformas similares. Familiaridade com barramentos e protocolos veiculares, como CAN, LIN e Ethernet. Experiência em laboratórios de validação, testes automotivos, testes de durabilidade, NVH ou engenharia experimental. Conhecimento de instrumentação e aquisição de dados em veículos. Experiência com análise de obsolescência e elaboração de roadmaps tecnológicos. Vivência na interface técnica com fornecedores e equipes internacionais.

title: Environment, health and safety coordinator joinville
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin: Where purpose comes to life.

You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.

Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it’s facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better.

Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

We are currently looking for a Head of Environment, Health, and Safety to join us at our team in Joinville . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.

The Role

This person will be responsible for leading and ensuring the national management of Industrial Safety, Environment and Occupational Health programs and activities.

Your Responsibilities: Guarantee compliance with applicable legal requirements on environmental, industrial safety and occupational health issues. Achieve zero accidents resulting from work activities. Reduce the incidence of occupational diseases. Establish action plans in Industrial Safety, Environment and Occupational Health (HSE).

Your Profile:

You have a degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Safety and Hygiene, Environment, health sciences, or similar fields. Desirable: Postgraduate in Safety and Hygiene, Environment, health sciences. You have +5 years of experience as a leader (supervisor, coordinator) in Safety and Hygiene, Environment & health in manufacturing industry. English proficiency, we will have our interview in English. The position requires preparing reports, attending audits and meetings in English. You are a teamplayer, motivator and excellent communicator with an entreprenaurial drive.

What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B& I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

Organization

Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B& I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B& I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

title: Business development & marketing
description:
About i QIYI

i QIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.

Role purpose

Support i QIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.

Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. description:

Estamos em busca de um líder estratégico e operacional, que goste de colocar a mão na massa para estruturar fluxos, otimizar rotinas, gerenciar inventários e garantir que a acuracidade e a agilidade sejam os motores da nossa eficiência diária.

Conhecimento avançado em inventário, acuracidade, conciliação e análise de divergências.

Domínio dos processos do CD (recebimento, armazenagem, movimentação, separação e expedição).

Excel avançado para tratamento, análise e conciliação de grandes volumes de dados.

⚙️ Conhecimento em mapeamento, melhoria contínua e automação de processos de estoque.

Capacidade analítica para elaborar relatórios gerenciais e estruturar planos de ação.

title: Estagiário de arquitetura
description:
Quem somos?

Com quase seis décadas de trajetória, a Breton construiu uma história sólida e se tornou referência no mercado de mobiliário de alto padrão. A marca é reconhecida pela sofisticação, pelo design autoral brasileiro e pelo compromisso com a responsabilidade ambiental e social, consolidando-se como uma das principais referências do segmento no Brasil.

Guiada por três pilares: Família, Sustentabilidade e Design Original Brasileiro, a Breton é uma empresa familiar com expertise na criação, no desenvolvimento e na produção de mobiliário com alto valor agregado. Esse processo passa por uma curadoria afiada de uma equipe multidisciplinar preparada para atender às mais diversas demandas de um mercado exigente e em constante evolução.

A Breton assume sua responsabilidade com a sustentabilidade por meio do Eco Breton, programa que direciona as iniciativas sustentáveis da marca em toda a operação, do uso de matérias primas certificadas à logística reversa. A empresa é certificada como Empresa B e é a única do segmento reconhecida como carbono negativo pelo GHG Protocol, compensando mais carbono do que emite.

Com mais de 20 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil, o principal diferencial da Breton é a personalização. Cada peça é altamente personalizável, em um processo próximo à alfaiataria de móveis, oferecendo aos clientes a liberdade de escolher medidas, tecidos e acabamentos.

Saiba mais em

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa estudante de Arquitetura , a partir do 4º semestre , para integrar nosso time e apoiar projetos que envolvem arquitetura, visualização 3 D e atividades administrativas da área.

Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de planilhas para processos de compras e análises de dados; Apoiar pesquisas e prospecção de novos parceiros e fornecedores para projetos de paisagismo, produção, Breton Casa , entre outros; Contribuir com pesquisas de mercado, relatórios e apresentações da área para outros departamentos; Apoiar o acompanhamento da manutenção das lojas de São Paulo, contribuindo para a impecabilidade dos espaços e fazendo a conexão entre a área e o time de Manutenção.

Perfil que buscamos Cursando Arquitetura a partir do 4º semestre ; Experiência prévia na área, escritório de arquitetura ou interiores será um diferencial; Perfil organizado, ágil, comunicativo e colaborativo ; Bom senso estético e interesse por arquitetura, design e visualização 3 D; Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

title: Client success manager - cx
description:
Location: Remote — Brazil

Type: Full-Time Contractor

Schedule: Monday–Friday, with consistent overlap with U. S. business hours

Compensation: Competitive based on location and experience.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Client Success Manager – CX to take a leadership role across our agency’s client accounts and customer experience function.

The individual who fills this role is responsible for the success of the clients they oversee. Our quality of work and client happiness is essential to our business and our CSM’s make that happen.

This is a hands-on, client-facing leadership position . You’ll manage client relationships and CX initiatives while also helping lead, train, develop, and support members of our CX team.

You’ll be expected to confidently lead calls with clients, present performance and recommendations, identify opportunities for improvement, and turn client goals into clear priorities for the team.

We’re looking for someone who is a critical thinker, self-directed learner, strong communicator, and compassionate leader . You should be comfortable taking ownership, figuring things out independently, and using data to guide decisions and establish measurable goals.

You’ll work across multiple e Commerce brands and help lead projects involving helpdesks, AI tools, automations, workflows, SOPs, migrations, reporting, and other CX initiatives.

What You’ll Be Doing

Client Success & CX Leadership Serve as a trusted point of contact for select client accounts Build strong relationships with U. S.-based clients Confidently lead client calls and presentations Gather, analyze and present CX performance, data, challenges, opportunities, recommendations, and next steps Understand each client’s brand, customer journey, policies, goals, and CX standards Handle escalated or complex customer and client situations when needed Identify recurring issues and proactively recommend solutions Turn client goals into clear priorities and action items for the team Communicate clearly with clients about projects, performance, blockers, timelines, and next steps Take ownership of problems and drive them toward resolution Understand our services offered and Identify opportunities to increase client scope

Team Leadership & Development Help lead and manage CX team members across multiple client accounts Train and onboard new team members Lead with compassion while maintaining clear standards and accountability Coach team members on communication, problem-solving, brand voice, and CX best practices Review team performance, quality of work and efficiencies Provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback Understand and manage team’s output and proper time tracking Identify skill gaps and opportunities for additional training Create training materials, SOPs, and documentation Delegate work effectively and ensure responsibilities are completed Help establish standards and accountability across the CX team Lead by example and step in when the team needs additional support

Data & Performance Pull, understand, and interpret CX performance data Identify trends, problems, and opportunities within the data Turn data into clear insights and recommendations Confidently present data and performance to clients Establish measurable, data-driven goals Track progress toward goals and identify areas for improvement Use data and critical thinking to guide decisions and recommendations

CX Systems & Implementation Lead and support CX implementations and process improvements Set up and optimize helpdesk workflows, tags, macros, rules, and automations Assist in CX adjacent tool buildout such as subscription and loyalty platforms Assist in CX adjacent brand community building efforts Lead or assist with helpdesk migrations and platform changes Implement and optimize AI-powered CX tools, chatbots, and automated workflows Scope, test, QA, and roll out new CX initiatives Create and maintain SOPs and operational documentation Identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements across client accounts Independently learn new tools, systems, and processes when needed

Agency & Project Management Manage multiple client accounts, projects, and priorities simultaneously Coordinate with internal teams to keep projects moving Support launches, migrations, audits, and special client initiatives Track action items and ensure commitments are followed through Proactively identify and solve problems rather than waiting for someone else to flag them Adapt quickly as client and agency priorities change Comfortable working with and overseeing your teams’ project management and time tracking tools

What We’re Looking For

MUST SPEAK ENGLISH FLUENTLY — excellent spoken and written English is required 3–5+ years of experience in client success, account management, customer experience, CX operations, e Commerce support, or a related role Previous experience leading, supervising, training, or mentoring a team Proven ability to train people and improve team performance Excellent client-facing communication and presentation skills Comfortable confidently leading calls with U. S.-based clients Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to learn new tools, systems, processes, and concepts independently Ability to lead a team with compassion while maintaining accountability Comfortable pulling, understanding, interpreting, and presenting performance data Able to use data to establish goals, measure performance, and guide decisions Experience managing multiple accounts, projects, and priorities Highly organized, dependable, and accountable Comfortable giving feedback and holding team members accountable Able to work independently and take ownership without constant supervision

Hands-on experience with e Commerce CX platforms is highly preferred, such as:

Helpdesks: Gorgias, Zendesk Subscriptions: Recharge, Stay AI, Skio Loyalty: Yotpo Reviews: Okendo, Yotpo AI support tools, automations, and chatbots

Bonus Points

Experience leading a remote CX team Experience with Gorgias implementations or migrations Experience implementing AI-powered CX tools Experience with Shopify and DTC/e Commerce brands Previous agency or startup experience Experience creating training programs, SOPs, and QA processes Experience managing U. S.-based clients

Required Video Submission

A video submission + resume are REQUIRED to be considered for this position. Applications without a video will not be considered.

This is a highly client-facing role. The person we hire will regularly lead calls, present information and performance, make recommendations, and represent our agency directly with clients.

Please submit a short video introducing yourself and explaining:

Why you believe you would be a good fit for this role How you approach solving problems and learning new things independently 1 example of a success story at a previous role

We’ll use the video to evaluate your English fluency, communication skills, confidence, professionalism, critical thinking, and presentation ability .

Email to camryn@ with the subject line Client Success Manager – CX Application

Você prevê conflitos antes que eles aconteçam, com base no conhecimento da dinâmica interpessoal e de grupo. A função exige, ainda, disciplina operacional, responsabilidade e zelo constante pelas pessoas, organização, segurança e ambiente de trabalho.

Para este cargo, você precisará: Formação superior em Engenharia (Qualidade, Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas); Experiência com qualificação de fornecedores e auditorias de qualidade; Inglês avançado (para contato com fornecedores internacionais); Conhecimento da ISO 9001; Mínimo 3 anos de experiência liderando equipes na área de Qualidade e laboratório de Qualidade; Conhecimentos avançados com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas; Local de trabalho: Barueri, SP.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam: Desejável Pós Graduação em Gestão / Engenharia da Qualidade e Certificações relacionadas; Conhecimento em Ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e 6-Sigma; Conhecimento em ERP Omega da ABC71 Familiaridade com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas Leitura e interpretação de documentos em inglês

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Sales & bd manager
description:
Brazil Sales & Business Development Manager

About Evoto AI

Evoto AI is a leading AI-powered photo and video editing platform used by creators, studios, and professionals worldwide. Our mission is to redefine creative workflows through cutting-edge AI technology — delivering speed, quality, and intelligent automation to visual storytellers everywhere.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated and commercially driven Brazil Sales & Business Development Manager based in São Paulo, Brazil to drive Evoto's customer acquisition and revenue growth across Brazil.

This is a hands-on, field-oriented sales role. You will be responsible for generating qualified leads, developing sales opportunities, acquiring new customers, and driving revenue across the Brazilian market.

You will leverage trade shows, photography communities, partnerships, outbound prospecting, and customer visits as key channels to generate leads and sales opportunities. You will own and close SMB opportunities directly, while partnering with our Key Account team on larger opportunities.

This is an early-stage role in Brazil, with significant ownership and the opportunity to help build Evoto's commercial presence across the region.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Business Development Generate new sales opportunities across Brazil through outbound prospecting, trade shows, communities, partnerships, referrals, and customer visits. Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline and convert qualified leads into revenue opportunities. Own the full sales cycle for SMB customers, from prospecting and product demonstrations to negotiation and closing. Identify and qualify larger opportunities and work with the Key Account team to transition and support strategic accounts. Build strong relationships with photographers, studios, creative professionals, and other potential customers. Meet and exceed sales targets and revenue goals. Maintain accurate sales activities and pipeline information in CRM systems.

Lead Generation & Market Development Attend and support Evoto's participation in photography trade shows, conferences, workshops, and industry events across Brazil, with a clear focus on lead generation and sales conversion. Develop relationships with photography communities, associations, educators, and industry partners to generate qualified leads and business opportunities. Conduct regular customer and prospect visits to identify opportunities and accelerate sales. Identify new customer segments, use cases, and business opportunities for Evoto. Follow up with leads generated through events, partnerships, and other channels to convert them into qualified opportunities.

Market Intelligence Build strong knowledge of the Brazilian photography and creative market. Gather customer feedback, competitor intelligence, and market insights through customer interactions and field activities. Share market insights with Product, Marketing, and other teams to support product and go-to-market decisions.

Qualifications 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, field sales, account management, or other customer-facing commercial roles. Proven track record of generating leads, building pipeline, and achieving sales targets. Experience independently managing and closing SMB opportunities. Experience working with photographers, studios, creative professionals, creator communities, or SMB customers is highly desirable. Experience in Saa S, software, creative technology, photography, media, or related industries is preferred. Strong prospecting, relationship-building, negotiation, and closing skills. Comfortable representing a company at trade shows, customer meetings, workshops, and industry events. Highly self-motivated, hands-on, and comfortable working independently in an early-stage market. Strong commercial mindset with a clear focus on leads, pipeline, and revenue. Experience using CRM tools such as Salesforce or Hub Spot is preferred. Native or professional proficiency in Portuguese is required. Business proficiency in English is required. Must be based in São Paulo, Brazil. Willingness to travel extensively across Brazil and occasionally across Latin America (approximately 30%).

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by:

Sales and revenue target achievement Qualified leads and SQLs generated Pipeline created and converted SMB customers acquired and deals closed Revenue generated through events, KOLs, partnerships, and other channels Development of a strong customer and partner network across Brazil

Why Join Evoto

About us

Broadsign is a leading programmatic ad tech company on a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our platform powers the world’s most successful OOH and retail media businesses while enabling agencies and brands to seamlessly plan and execute dynamic OOH campaigns across the globe. Come light up the world as a Sales Director.

Position Summary

Your day-to-day will vary but your mission is simple; as a key member of our Programmatic Team, you will be taking full responsibility for business development activities by educating buyers on the new opportunities brought forth by our products. Your patch will consist of media buyers from agencies, brands and DSP partners. You’ll put your sales experience to use by determining client needs and recommending optimal programmatic DOOH proposals and supporting agency-wide agreements.

Of course, if this role speaks to you, you’re someone who has; 5-10 years sales experience in the media world; you understand agencies and what advertisers care about Proven understanding of the digital programmatic world and/or the programmatic digital out-of-home ecosystem Interest in engaging with new buyers by introducing them to the benefits of programmatic DOOH and the innovative advertising opportunities via the Broadsign programmatic stack Excellent presentation skills - you know how to craft a pitch Strong organisational skills You have the ability to manage multiple tasks and perform well under pressure Great communication and collaborative approach with teammates This is a primarily remote role; however, we believe face-to-face connection drives the best results. You will be expected to make a best-effort approach to conducting in-person client meetings. To support your success, you will have full access to We Work spaces. Travel will primarily be within Brazil for client meetings, with occasional travel throughout LATAM for industry and company events. This role requires professional fluency in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is highly advantageous.

What we bring to the table Health & Dental Insurance: Supplemental private medical and dental coverage for you and your dependents. You’ll also have access to unlimited online mental health support through Better Help for you and your family. Wellness & Remote Fund: R$ 3,000 annual flexible budget for home office, wellness, or internet expenses Paid Time Off: Statutory 30 calendar days of paid rest after 12 months, plus the mandatory 1/3 vacation bonus, 5 "floater" days, 2 paid volunteer days, and 3 paid training days per year! Daycare Assistance: Monthly financial support/reimbursement for early-childhood daycare ( Auxílio-Creche ) Family Support: Parental leave salary supplement. Growth Opportunities: Training & development opportunities with a yearly budget to support professional growth.

At Broadsign, we value the varied social identities that make up our community. We recognize talent comes in different forms and encourage applications that reflect different backgrounds and experiences. Our promise is to be an inclusive employer and partner, open to learning, with thoughtful strategies and practices that amplify the different voices of our industry.

description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Bombeiro(a) para atuar no time de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho.

Quais as responsabilidades?

Atuar nas emergências conforme os procedimentos operacionais padrão de cada cenário emergencial;

Organizar, capacitar e coordenar as brigadas industriais e agrícolas;

Conduzir veículos de emergência (ambulância e caminhão pipa);

Programar e executar teste, inspeção, ensaio, limpeza, substituição e/ou reposição de equipamentos, veículos, sistemas de proteção de combate a incêndio e de atendimento as emergências;

Treinar os brigadistas em combate a incêndio, vazamentos de produtos químicos, primeiros socorros e outros;

Registrar as intervenções, elaborar relatórios de simulados, intercorrências e atas de turno;

Organizar, conduzir e ou coordenar simulado de emergências conforme os cenários de riscos mapeados.

Quais os requisitos?

Curso de bombeiro profissional civil (vigente);

CNH C ou D;

Curso de transporte de veículos de emergência (vigente);

Pacote Office;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia - SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
O que buscamos num profissional?

Em um momento de expansão e foco em soluções inovadoras de ingredientes, procuramos um(a) profissional Sênior com perfil HUNTER e sólida experiência no mercado B2 B.

O profissional ideal terá uma abordagem estratégica, forte capacidade de negociação e um profundo conhecimento técnico sobre o universo de amidos e adoçantes, com o foco principal em identificar, prospectar e fechar novos clientes de grande potencial.

Buscamos um talento que seja protagonista na expansão da carteira , capaz de traduzir a excelência técnica dos nossos produtos em valor para os clientes, fortalecendo nossa posição nos segmentos de Panificação, Biscoitos, Confeitos e Bebidas.

Que desafio temos para você?

O(A) Executivo(a) de Vendas Sênior (Hunter) será responsável por alavancar o crescimento da empresa por meio da conquista de novos clientes de grande e médio porte, com foco nas indústrias de Panificação (Pães, biscoitos, premix etc.) Confeitos (balas, doces etc.) e Bebidas (cervejarias, destilados, iogurtes, sucos) .

O principal objetivo é impulsionar o volume de vendas e a margem de lucro, por meio de um ciclo de vendas consultivo e técnico, utilizando seu conhecimento especializado em ingredientes como amidos, xaropes, dextrose, e outros adoçantes.

Local: São Paulo/SP (modelo híbrido, com base na estrutura da empresa).

Quais as Responsabilidades Principais? Prospecção e Conquista de Novos Clientes (Foco Hunter): Liderar a identificação, qualificação e prospecção ativas de novos Key Accounts nos segmentos de foco, elaborando e defendendo propostas técnicas e comerciais estratégicas. Gestão da Carteira Chave: Gerenciar e expandir a carteira de clientes B2 B chave, garantindo a retenção e o share após a fase de conquista. Conhecimento Técnico Especializado: Atuar como consultor(a) técnico-comercial, utilizando o conhecimento de Amidos e Adoçantes (incluindo as suas aplicações e processos produtivos nos mercados de Panificação, Confeitos e Bebidas). Planejamento e Previsão: Elaborar e monitorar a previsão de vendas ( forecast ) de forma acurada, garantindo o alinhamento com os planos de produção e a estratégia comercial. Negociação e Contratos: Conduzir negociações complexas de volume e preço, garantindo o cumprimento de contratos, prazos e padrões de qualidade. Análise de Mercado: Monitorar tendências de mercado, atividades da concorrência e inovações para informar a estratégia de vendas. Relacionamento Interno: Colaborar de forma eficaz com as equipes de P& D/Aplicação, Marketing, Logística e Financeiro para garantir a excelência na entrega.

Quais os requisitos e qualificações?

Perfil Hunter Comprovado: Histórico de sucesso e experiência em abertura e desenvolvimento de novos mercados/clientes B2 B (diferencial mandatório). Formação: Graduação completa em áreas correlatas (Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Alimentos, Química Industrial, Administração, Economia ou afins). Experiência Sênior: Experiência consolidada e hands-on em vendas B2 B de ingredientes alimentícios . Expertise no Setor: Profundo conhecimento e carteira de relacionamento estabelecida nos mercados de Panificação, Confeitos e/ou Bebidas . (Diferencial) Conhecimento em Amidos e Adoçantes: Experiência comprovada na comercialização de produtos como Amidos, Maltodextrina, Xaropes de Glicose, Dextrose, Adoçantes (naturais/artificiais) ou ingredientes similares. Habilidades de Negociação: Domínio de técnicas avançadas de negociação e gestão de contas complexas. Ferramentas: Experiência robusta com CRM (preferencialmente Salesforce ). Pacote Office (Excel e Power Point) em nível avançado. Idiomas: Inglês Fluente (Mandatório) e Espanhol Fluente (Diferencial) Experiência em atendimento B2 B na América Latina será considerado diferencial. Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes dentro do território nacional (aproximadamente 60% do tempo).

O que oferecemos?

Remuneração e bônus atrativos compatíveis com a experiência sênior e focados em atingimento de novas metas (Hunter) . Pacote de benefícios Premium e completo. Oportunidade de atuar com um portfólio de produtos de alta qualidade e inovação. Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e desafiador.

Benefícios Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Auxílio Farmácia Vale-Alimentação e Vale-Refeição Previdência Privada Plataforma Galena PMR - Participação nas Metas e Resultados Veículo Corporativo: Automóvel compatível com a função, com todas as despesas (combustível, manutenção, seguro etc.) custeadas pela empresa para o exercício das atividades profissionais

title: Analista de hsse jr
description:
Sobre Nós

Na gategourmet, estamos empenhados em criar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, colaborativo e orientado para o crescimento. Recebemos candidatos de todas as origens e acreditamos que equipes diversas impulsionam a inovação e a excelência.

1. Objetivo do Cargo

Atuar no suporte às atividades de Health, Safety, Security & Environment (HSSE), com foco nas rotinas de AVSEC (Segurança da Aviação Civil contra Atos de interferência Ilícita), contribuindo para o cumprimento dos requisitos legais, regulatórios e dos procedimentos internos aplicáveis à operação.

Realizar atividades de acompanhamento, controle, inspeção, monitoramento, treinamento e suporte às auditorias, visando à prevenção de não conformidades e à manutenção dos padrões de segurança.

2. Principais Responsabilidades Apoiar a implementação, manutenção e melhoria dos procedimentos e controles relacionados à AVSEC; Realizar inspeções de rotina e verificações de segurança nas áreas operacionais, identificando desvios, riscos e situações de não conformidade; Acompanhar o cumprimento dos procedimentos relacionados à AVSEC; Registrar, acompanhar e auxiliar no tratamento de não conformidades, ocorrências e oportunidades de melhoria; Acompanhar auditorias e inspeções de órgãos reguladores e clientes; Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e atualização de procedimentos, instruções de trabalho, formulários, materiais de treinamento e comunicações internas; Aplicar e controlar treinamentos relacionados à AVSEC; Realizar orientações aos colaboradores e prestadores de serviço quanto ao cumprimento dos procedimentos de segurança; Manter os registros e documentos da área organizados e disponíveis para consultas e auditorias; Acompanhar os serviços prestados pela empresa de segurança patrimonial/vigilância, verificando o cumprimento dos procedimentos estabelecidos; Comunicar imediatamente situações de risco, desvios ou ocorrências que possam comprometer a segurança da operação; Participar de investigações e análises de ocorrências relacionadas à segurança, contribuindo para a identificação de causas e definição de ações corretivas e preventivas; Participar da Comissão de Segurança Aeroportuária.

3. Requisitos

Formação

Ensino Técnico ou Ensino Superior completo/cursando em Gestão de Segurança, Segurança do Trabalho, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência

Desejável experiência em ambiente aeroportuário.

Conhecimentos Conhecimento em elaboração e controle de documentos e registros; Conhecimento em auditorias e tratamento de não conformidades; Pacote Office; Desejável conhecimento das normas e requisitos AVSEC e regulamentação da ANAC.

4. Competências Organização; Senso de responsabilidade e disciplina operacional; Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; Capacidade de identificar riscos e desvios; Perfil analítico e senso crítico; Proatividade e iniciativa; Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe; Facilidade para realizar atividades em campo e interagir com diferentes áreas; Postura profissional e ética; Capacidade de atuar em situações que demandem agilidade e tomada de decisão.

title: Learning support teacher
description:
Job Overview: 

The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.

Core Responsibilities:

Student Support & Intervention Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support. Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies. Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward. Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities. Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills. Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning. Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered. Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans. Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success. Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies. Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans. Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding. Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles. Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required. Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family. Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration. Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments. Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children. Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs. Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers. Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented). Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.

Collaboration Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension. Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports. Monitor students’ progress and well-being. Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners. Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning. Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children. Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning. Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load. Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed. Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.

Operational and Professional Conduct Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies. Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress. Maintain accurate student records. Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods. Participate in professional development opportunities. Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned. Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines. Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide .

Other duties, as assigned.

Working Conditions: Walk on paths and rough terrain May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education Required:  

BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent

Minimum Experience Required: Five years of teaching experience, preferred Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences. Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.

Specific Knowledge: Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners. Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented. Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.

Other Skills (Desirable): Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills. Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven. Collegial and collaborative. Innovative and creative. Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.

English level required:

C1 or above

Portuguese level required:

none for teachers instructing in English

C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Consultor comercial ( bauru-sp)
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Não estamos procurando um mero "vendedor de loja" ou alguém para apenas "tirar pedidos" fazer medidas e preencher documentos. Buscamos um Consultor Comercial Premium , com sensibilidade estética, alta capacidade de relacionamento e foco em grandes negociações. Nesta vaga, você será o embaixador da Studio Kitchens, conectando nossos móveis planejados e eletrodomésticos premium aos melhores projetos do mercado. ⚠️ Atenção: Profissionais de vendas de alto padrão são objetivos e focados em resultados. Candidatos que enviarem currículos em anexo sem o link do vídeo, ou vídeos com mais de 2 minutos, serão desclassificados automaticamente. Mostre o seu poder de síntese e magnetismo.

Negociação e Fechamento de Alto Padrão: Conduzir negociações complexas de alto valor (tickets elevados) com inteligência emocional, elegância e foco na superação de metas.

O que você vai dominar e gerenciar (O dia a dia) Universo Premium e Luxo: Dominar os diferenciais técnicos, tecnologias e o design das marcas de eletrodomésticos premium e dos nossos móveis planejados. Gestão de Pipeline e Pós-Venda: Alimentar o CRM com precisão para acompanhar cada etapa da jornada de compra e garantir que a transição para a equipe de engenharia/montagem seja impecável.

title: Analista de compras internacionais
description:
Descrição de Cargo — Analista de Compras Internacionais

Cargo

Analista de Compras Internacionais

Objetivo do cargo

Responsável por conduzir e acompanhar processos de compras internacionais, desde a pesquisa e negociação com fornecedores até o acompanhamento da produção, embarque, importação e chegada da mercadoria.

O profissional deverá buscar redução de custos, segurança nas operações, cumprimento de prazos e melhoria contínua do processo de abastecimento internacional da empresa.

Principais responsabilidades

Pesquisar, prospectar e desenvolver fornecedores internacionais. Solicitar e comparar cotações de produtos. Negociar preços, condições de pagamento, quantidade mínima de compra, prazos de produção e condições comerciais. Elaborar análises comparativas de fornecedores. Calcular e acompanhar o custo total de importação dos produtos. Emitir e acompanhar pedidos de compra internacionais. Conferir Proforma Invoice, Commercial Invoice, Packing List e demais documentos relacionados à importação. Acompanhar pagamentos aos fornecedores. Monitorar cronogramas de produção e cobrar cumprimento dos prazos acordados. Acompanhar inspeções de qualidade quando necessário. Manter contato frequente com fornecedores internacionais. Acompanhar embarques marítimos, aéreos ou expressos. Trabalhar em conjunto com despachantes aduaneiros, agentes de carga e demais parceiros da operação. Controlar previsão de chegada das mercadorias. Atualizar informações de pedidos e importações nos sistemas e controles internos da empresa. Identificar atrasos, riscos e divergências, propondo soluções rapidamente. Desenvolver indicadores de desempenho de fornecedores. Buscar oportunidades de redução de custos de compra, frete e operação. Apoiar o planejamento de compras e reposição de estoque. Analisar histórico de vendas, estoque e giro dos produtos para apoiar decisões de compra. Manter organizada toda a documentação referente às importações. Participar do desenvolvimento e lançamento de novos produtos.

Competências técnicas desejadas

Conhecimento de processos de importação. Conhecimento de negociação internacional. Excel ou Google Sheets intermediário ou avançado. Capacidade de realizar análises de custos e formação de preço. Conhecimento de Incoterms. Conhecimento básico de logística internacional. Familiaridade com Commercial Invoice, Packing List e Proforma Invoice. Inglês intermediário ou avançado para comunicação com fornecedores. Conhecimento de sistemas ERP será considerado diferencial. Experiência com fornecedores da China será considerada diferencial.

Competências comportamentais

Buscamos uma pessoa com:

Velocidade de execução: capacidade de resolver demandas rapidamente e evitar que processos fiquem parados. Capacidade analítica: facilidade para comparar preços, fornecedores, custos e alternativas. Raciocínio lógico: capacidade de identificar problemas e encontrar soluções. Organização: acompanhamento rigoroso de pedidos, documentos, pagamentos e prazos. Senso de urgência: percepção rápida de situações que podem gerar atrasos ou prejuízos. Proatividade: antecipar problemas e buscar soluções sem depender constantemente da liderança. Capacidade de negociação: buscar melhores condições comerciais preservando o relacionamento com fornecedores. Atenção aos detalhes: identificar erros em documentos, preços, quantidades ou condições negociadas. Comunicação objetiva: transmitir informações de maneira clara para fornecedores e equipe interna. Responsabilidade: assumir o acompanhamento dos processos até sua conclusão.

Indicadores de desempenho do cargo

O desempenho poderá ser acompanhado por indicadores como:

Redução do custo médio de compra. Economia obtida através de negociações. Cumprimento do prazo de produção dos fornecedores. Percentual de pedidos entregues dentro do prazo. Redução de erros em pedidos e documentação. Lead time médio das importações. Giro e cobertura de estoque. Número de novos fornecedores homologados. Redução de rupturas de estoque. Margem dos produtos importados. Índice de problemas de qualidade. Tempo médio de resolução de problemas com fornecedores.

Requisitos

Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Logística, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas relacionadas. Experiência prévia com compras, comércio exterior, importação ou negociação com fornecedores. Inglês suficiente para comunicação escrita e reuniões com fornecedores. Boa capacidade de utilização de planilhas e análise de dados.

Diferenciais

Experiência com importação da China. Experiência com Alibaba, 1688 ou plataformas de fornecedores internacionais. Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de produtos e private label. Experiência com móveis, produtos corporativos, e-commerce ou varejo. Conhecimento de classificação fiscal/NCM. Experiência com análise de estoque e planejamento de compras.

Perfil ideal

O profissional ideal para esta posição é alguém rápido, analítico e muito organizado , que consiga acompanhar diversos pedidos simultaneamente sem perder prazos ou detalhes.

Deve ter facilidade para trabalhar com números, negociar, cobrar fornecedores e tomar decisões com base em dados.

Mais do que simplesmente emitir pedidos de compra, esperamos que o Analista de Compras Internacionais atue como responsável pela performance das compras, buscando constantemente melhores preços, melhores fornecedores, menores prazos e maior rentabilidade para a empresa.

title: Gerente de projetos
description:
Se você é um(a) profissional de Gerenciamento de Projetos em busca de uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, esta posição oferece a oportunidade de planejar, organizar e controlar recursos e processos para atingir os objetivos de projetos e programas dentro das restrições de escopo, prazo, qualidade e orçamento. O(a) Gerente de Projetos supervisiona os diversos projetos de engenharia implementados pela empresa para garantir que estejam alinhados à missão da organização e aos objetivos estratégicos dos programas.

A equipe de liderança da empresa normalmente define a direção estratégica e os resultados que deseja alcançar. Com base nisso, o(a) Gerente Sênior de Projetos monitora o progresso de vários projetos sob sua responsabilidade para garantir que sigam essa direção e superem as metas estabelecidas.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1. Liderança Técnica

Responsável pela orientação técnica geral dos projetos, incluindo definições de engenharia, decisões de desenvolvimento e integração entre diferentes disciplinas técnicas.

2. Controle de Cronograma e Custos

Desenvolver planos de trabalho, gerenciar orçamentos de projetos, acompanhar a alocação de recursos e realizar análises de custos para garantir a execução eficiente das atividades.

3. Conformidade com Qualidade e Segurança

Assegurar o cumprimento de normas do setor, requisitos de segurança (como diretrizes HSE ou ISO) e especificações técnicas de projeto.

4. Comunicação com Stakeholders

Atuar como principal ponto de contato técnico entre clientes, fornecedores externos e liderança executiva.

5. Mitigação de Riscos

Identificar possíveis obstáculos ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos de engenharia e implementar ações corretivas para minimizar impactos e garantir o sucesso das entregas.

Quem você é:

Você trabalha de forma colaborativa, contribuindo para um ambiente respeitoso e inclusivo, onde o aprendizado e a troca de conhecimento são valorizados. Demonstra atenção aos detalhes, disciplina e comprometimento com a qualidade e a integridade dos dados técnicos. Atua com responsabilidade e ética, seguindo procedimentos e normas, ao mesmo tempo em que busca aprender continuamente e melhorar a forma como o trabalho é realizado.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

Graduação em Comércio Internacional e/ou Engenharia (Industrial, Química ou áreas correlatas). Entre 10 e 12 anos de experiência em gestão de projetos para candidatos externos. Entre 5 e 7 anos de experiência para candidatos internos. Certificação PMP® (Project Management Professional) ou outra certificação reconhecida pelo PMI (Project Management Institute) será considerada um diferencial. Inglês avançado.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Finance manager
description:

Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards.

Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk. Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail. Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.

What we offer: Competitive salary and benefits. Opportunities for professional growth and development. A collaborative and innovative work environment. The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.

Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Mandarin is a plus Job type: Full Time

title: Senior accounting manager
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement.

The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounting Manager to run the accounting operation for US-based client companies, working remotely from Brazil.

This is a senior management seat reporting to the Controller or Head of Accounting, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will manage the close, manage the accounting team, and hold first-line accountability for the accuracy of what the function produces before it reaches final review.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who fixes them and writes down how they now work.

You will work closely with the finance leadership, and directly with the operators whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

Because your team sits outside the United States and the leadership you report to does not, the role calls for someone who runs their area without needing to be managed through it, escalates early rather than at review, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture across a time difference.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time. The financial statements. Prepare the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced. Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on. Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review. Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation. Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage. Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you. Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller. External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations and Team

The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards. Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them. Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast. The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands. Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across Net Suite, Quick Books Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.

What We're Looking For

8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Quick Books Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , or Rippling Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded Saa S or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

Run the close and manage the accounting team, with direct visibility to US finance leadership Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities Gain hands-on exposure to audits, ERP transformations, and control build-outs rather than observing them Progress toward Controller, Head of Accounting, and Head of Finance opportunities through MAVI Compensation in USD, paid reliably and on schedule

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will be placed with a single US client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts, and you will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazil business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.
